The two PNGs are **generated regression fixtures**, not the user's menu images.

- `synthetic-small-red-traditional.png`: 149 × 28, dark-red 免治牛肉石頭飯 on a pale background, Noto Serif CJK Bold at 18px.
- `synthetic-clean-chinese.png`: large black 我喜欢咖啡 on white, Noto Sans CJK at 78px.

Both exercise the actual packaged RapidOCR model in pytest. Exact-image benchmarking of the user's inline chat photos requires the original file to be available to the test process; do not describe these fixtures as those originals.
